extra.message: The user-controlled name parameter is interpolated into a string and parsed as a Jinja template via Template(content).render(). An attacker can inject Jinja expressions and potentially achieve server-side code execution.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code

extra.message: The name query parameter is inserted directly into HTML without escaping. An attacker can supply HTML or JavaScript that is reflected in the response and executed in victims' browsers.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: A secret token is hardcoded in source code as SUPER_SECRET_TOKEN. Anyone with repository or deployed-source access can recover and reuse this credential.
